outcome: duration of second stage of labor
cohort: The study included 80 pregnant women with fetuses in cephalic presentation in the second stage of labor.
finding: Higher angle of progression (AoP) is associated with shorter induction time, shorter duration of the second stage of labor, and higher neonatal Apgar scores.
mod_finding: Higher progression angle is associated with a higher chance of spontaneous vaginal delivery, and there was a significant difference in AoP between normal vaginal delivery, cesarean section, and vacuum-assisted delivery groups.
cross-section timing: During the second stage of labor
